scenario: [LCAP.2.1.5] / [LDIA.3.2.3]: the built-in `realtime` dialect is deferred with the capability, so `use realtime` is refused with DS_VALIDATE_REALTIME_DEFERRED, at the dialect name. The name is known, so a compiler that dropped the dialect from its table reports DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_DIALECT instead; one that still admits it reports DS_VALIDATE_COMPILE_MISSING_DSRT, since there is no sibling `.dsrt`. PATH PINNED: dialect-name resolution in `dsc.dialect`, the arm for the `realtime` name.
rules_ds:
use realtime

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
